items.text: Compare Folio3 vs Other Microsoft Partners

items.text: Velosio leads with Dynamics 365 and Oracle NetSuite ERP implementation; Folio3 leads with Azure cloud, data engineering and AI. See the honest, source-backed, side-by-side breakdown — including where Velosio is genuinely strong and where Folio3 differentiates.
